title: LLM trace span (recommended)
description: One JSON object per line (JSONL). One span per model call or per user request; keep the same trace_id across the spans of one request. Field names align in spirit with the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions; map them in your exporter.

trace_id.description: Correlates spans of one request; also links feedback and eval failures.

ts.description: Span start, ISO 8601 with timezone (UTC recommended).

feature.description: Product feature or route; `route` is accepted as an alias.

model.description: Provider model id and version actually called.

prompt_version.description: Prompt/template version, so drift can be attributed.

cost_usd.description: Billed or metered cost for this span. Omit when unknown; never estimate.

eval_score.description: Online eval / judge score on the scale your eval harness uses.
